sections.heading: Subject-Matter Insured
sections.body: Ductile iron (DI) pipes, mild steel (MS) pipes with epoxy lining, HDPE pipes and coils, specials, valves, flanges, sluice gates, pumping-station accessories and allied materials meant for water-supply pipeline projects, packed as per normal trade practice. Basis of valuation: invoice value plus 10 percent.

sections.heading: Voyage and Conveyance
sections.body: Transit by rail and/or road (by registered public carriers or the Insured's own vehicles) from any manufacturer's works or vendor's godown within India to project sites, site stores and intermediate stockyards situated in the State of Odisha, including incidental loading and unloading. Transit-wise declarations shall be submitted monthly to the issuing office.

sections.heading: Conditions and Clauses
sections.body: Inland Transit Clause (A) - All Risks for rail/road, subject to Strikes, Riots and Civil Commotion Clause (Inland Transit), Sanction Limitation and Exclusion Clause and Termination of Transit Clause (Terrorism). Excess: 1 percent of claim amount subject to a minimum as per schedule. Rusting, oxidation, discolouration and denting of pipes not affecting serviceability are excluded.

sections.heading: Claims Procedure
sections.body: In the event of loss or damage, notify the issuing office and the nearest surveyor appointed by the Company immediately and in any case within 7 days of receipt of consignment. Lodge a monetary claim on the carrier in writing within the statutory period and preserve recovery rights. Submit invoice, lorry receipt/railway receipt, packing list, survey report and claim bill.

sections.heading: Important Notice
sections.body: This certificate is issued under and subject to the terms of the Open Policy referenced above. Stamp duty has been paid by the Company in accordance with the Indian Stamp Act, 1899. For grievances, contact the Grievance Redressal Officer at the issuing office or approach the Insurance Ombudsman, Bhubaneswar. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation.
